Security fix for `existing_connection`.

If your `connection_dsn` had the password in a URL query string (`?password=...`), in quotes, or written as `password = x`, restoredrill copied it into the report. Reports go to any webhook or Slack sink you configured. v0.4.3 removes it in all of these forms. The password also used to sit on the `psql` command line, where other users on the same machine could read it while a drill ran. It now goes to `psql` through `PGPASSWORD`.

# GitHub Social Agent v1.0.0

The first public release of **GitHub Social Agent** — an open-source developer discovery agent that analyses GitHub profiles and finds developers who are technically relevant to your interests.

## What it does

GitHub Social Agent explores the GitHub follower graph, collects repository and developer data, and ranks users by similarity to your own technical profile.

The project is designed for **targeted developer discovery**, not mass-following or follower farming.
